description: Choose one card from three random class-appropriate cards.
name: Acquire

description: The primary resource used to play cards and activate class skills.
name: Action Point

description: The resource container used to hold the primary game resource.
name: Action Point Slot

description: Adds the specified card(s) to the player's hand.
name: Add Card

description: Affects all characters of the stated type.
name: Area of Effect

description: A form of secondary Health available only to players.
name: Armor

description: An effect that's only triggered if the stated conditions are met.
name: Boolean

description: Temporarily makes an element, be that minion or player, more powerful.
name: Boon

description: Absorbs the first source of any damage, removing the shield.
name: Bubble

description: Permanently makes an element, be that minion or player, more powerful.
name: Buff

description: Minion cannot attack.
name: Can't Attack

description: Changes the cost of relative card(s).
name: Change Cost

description: Triggers an effect when played from the hand if you already played another card this turn.
name: Combo

description: May not be the target of enemy attacks, spells, or abilities until they attack or deal damage. Once they attack or deal damage, the ability is removed. Minions with this ability can still be affected by AoE spells.
shortDescription: Can't be targeted, but can take AOE damage.
name: Concealed

description: Deals the specified damage.
name: Deal Damage

description: Permanently or temporarily makes an element, be that minion or player, less powerful.
name: Debuff

description: A triggered effect which activates when the minion dies. It is identified by a skull and crossbones that appears at the bottom of the minion's portrait.
name: Demise

description: Destroys a target without dealing damage to it.
name: Destroy

description: Cannot attack while ability is active.
name: Disable

description: Removes the specified card(s) from a player's hand.
name: Discard

description: Causes the player to draw one or more cards from their deck.
name: Draw Card

description: A weapon's Health value.
name: Durability

description: Effects that activate in response to specific events.
name: Event

description: Destroys a target at the start of your next turn.
shortDescription: Remove minion on your next turn.
name: Expiration

description: Casts a global spell.
name: Global Spell

description: A minion ability which forces the opposing player to direct any melee attacks toward enemy targets with this ability.
shortDescription: Forces melee damage to this ability.
name: Guard

description: Heals target for specific amount(s).
name: Heal

description: Prevents damage dealt from any source to the target, and prevents all enemy interaction with the target.
name: Immune

description: Damage dealt also restores Health to the controlling player.
name: Lifesteal

description: A type of spell card that remains hidden until its trigger condition occurs, revealing it, and triggering its effect. Can only be activated during the opponent's turn, but some exceptions activate at the start of the player's next turn. Only one can be in play for a given player at a time.
name: Mystery

description: Gives minions an ability that renders them unable to be targeted by spells, items, or Hero Abilities.
shortDescription: Can't be targeted by spells, items, and skills.
name: No Target

description: Actives at the end of the player's turn.
name: On Turn End

description: An ability which allows a character to attack twice per turn.
name: Onslaught

description: You have {X} less mana next turn. This effect is activated when the card is played from the hand, and typically allows a powerful card to be played for a low mana cost this round, at the price of reduced mana next turn.
name: Overcharge

description: Effects which include some degree of randomness or 'RNG' (random number generation).
name: Random

description: Sets a minion's current Health value back to its total Health value.
name: Restore

description: Take a minion off the battlefield and return it to the owning player's hand.
shortDescription: Move minion from board to hand.
name: Return

description: Summons the specified target(s).
name: Revive

description: Gives the controlling player the ability to choose between two or more effects stated in the card.
name: Select One

description: Assigns a new value for something's Attack, Health, or Cost, or Durability.
name: Set Value

description: Increases the output of your damaging spells.
name: Spell Damage

description: Enables the minion to attack on the same turn that it is summoned.
name: Stampede

description: Transfers ownership of the targeted minion.
name: Steal

description: Summons the specified minion(s).
name: Summon

description: Removes all card text, enchantments, and abilities from the target minion, except for auras provided by external cards in play.
shortDescription: Removes all boons, buffs, debuffs, and mechanics.
name: Suppress

description: Allows the player to choose a target for which the effect incurs upon.
shortDescription: Allows player to choose a target.
name: Target

description: Any minion damaged with this ability minion is destroyed.
name: Touch of Death

description: Changes a minion into something else irreversibly, entirely replacing the previous card.
name: Transform

description: A triggered effect which activates when the card is played from your hand.
name: Warcry
